Neutral vote. This was a little overly exposition-y for my tastes, and I do think the line at the end doesn't have sufficient setup to work properly. Nevertheless, I'm invoking the "this was interesting enough that I would read more of it if it was there" clause for this one. The idea of the Black Queen used in this manner was one that has some moves, I think.

I'm also refraining from a downvote because one of my issues, the fact that this is a little too close format-wise to a mainlist article, is an issue with the pre-existing template and not any choices made by the writer.

I am talking about the last line:

it would be kind of you to refer to me as a human even though i might not look it

Which looks purple to me, and the Page Source says it is the same color as Adrelintha's other statements.

Unless Zmax is saying that she isn't her at all even at the beginning, which I suppose the bit about her not updating her records makes sense, but if Hull was supposed to have replaced her then this is a major plot point that goes absolutely nowhere. I also have no idea why Hull would infiltrate the Queens, set up an agenda about sharing intelligence about himself and then reveal himself to potentially dangerous enemies at the end. Or why the other Queens are silent afterwards.

I don't understand what the context of that last, purple line is.
